Dosing is something I can't give you — that's a medical call, and getting it wrong in either direction matters too much.

**Call your pediatric office or a nurse line right now.** They can give you the exact dose based on Sol's current weight (dosing is weight-based, not just age-based), confirm whether Tylenol is appropriate at 6 months, and tell you whether 39.5°C needs to be seen today.

If you can't reach your clinic quickly, **Health811** (dial 8-1-1) is Ontario's 24/7 nurse line — or your province's equivalent — and they handle exactly this kind of question.
